notes.title: Update notes for version 1.5.4
notes.content:
[u][b]1.5.4 -[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] 	Now using a universal binary built for Apple Silicon and 64-bit Intel

[*] 	Refines the conditions for one of the endings, and fixes misc bugs.
[/list]
